description: Generate N perturbed variants around an anchor parameter look and write the whole pack to the Obsidian vault as a morph_pack-compatible JSON. Probes the target COMP's customPars for slider ranges to clamp + integer-round per param, then perturbs each variant uniformly within ±delta_range × (normMax − normMin). The resulting file is consumed directly by morph_pack (action=unpack). Requires TDMCP_VAULT_PATH.

comp_path.description: COMP whose customPars give slider ranges for clamping. Defaults to target_path else parent.

delta_range.description: Perturbation magnitude as fraction of each param's slider span.

include_seed.description: If true, slot v00 is the seed look itself.

name.description: Pack name. File defaults to MorphPacks/<name>.morphpack.json.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing pack file.

seed_look.description: Anchor look: { paramName: number }. Names must be numeric custom pars on comp_path.

target_path.description: Recorded into provenance.target_path so morph_pack can unpack standalone.

vault_path.description: Override default MorphPacks/<name>.morphpack.json. Resolved via Vault.resolve.

name: variant_pack
title: Generate a stochastic variant pack from a seed look
